while True:
    try:
        x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
    except EOFError:
        break

    if y <= n:
        a = x
        b = y
    else:
        min_value = 1.0
        a, b = 0, 0
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            k = (i * x) // y
            mi = (x / y) - (k / i)
            if mi < min_value:
                min_value = mi
                a = k
                b = i
            mi = ((k + 1) / i) - (x / y)
            if mi < min_value:
                min_value = mi
                a = k + 1
                b = i

    if a > b:
        m, n_val = a, b
    else:
        m, n_val = b, a

    if n_val == 0:
        m = 1
    else:
        while n_val:
            j = m % n_val
            m, n_val = n_val, j

    if j != 1:
        a //= m
        b //= m

    print(f"{a}/{b}")
</translated_code>
